name: SimplifiedDiodeModels
_comment_en: Diode small-signal template - Simplified level (Analog Insydes SimplifiedDiodeSmallSignal, simp==1). The only diode-model simplification is neglecting the series ohmic RS, so the Simplified topology equals Basic: R_eq (REQ) in parallel with C_d (CAP) across A-C. Value resolution in netlist/Model.py._diode_ac_param_values.
